summary.en: After bowling, Ran, Sonoko, and Conan head to the bank to cash a check. While there, an armed bank robbery happens. After some struggle, one man is shot by the robber but survives. After being shot, another man struggles with the robber and ends up shooting and killing the robber. It all seems normal but Conan finds it strange. After figuring out the robber had an accomplice, Conan, using Sonoko, reveals the robber's accomplice. Location: Tohto Bank Culprit: Touru Saeki Location: Tohto Bank Victim: Tetsuya Maejima Injury: Gunshot wound to chest Culprit: Touru Saeki Location: Tohto Bank Cause of death: Gunshot wound Culprit: Noboru Taniguchi When Tetsuya Mejima was shot, Taniguchi fought against the robber, then they heard a gunshot. When Conan goes behind the counter, he saw the robber dead. Was this a self-defense or a murder?
